_comment: Krea-2 (K2) SINGLE-GPU offload LoRA fine-tune. See krea2/train.py. The whole 12.8B DiT is diced into one chunk per block and streams from pinned CPU RAM through a small GPU window; the frozen Qwen3-VL encoder streams the same way. Needs ~30 GB host RAM for the bf16 DiT masters + grad accumulators + AdamW state on the LoRA params.
_comment_topology: parallelism: 'offload' = 1 GPU with weight streaming, 'pipeline' = N GPUs resident, 'pipeline-offload' = N GPUs with streaming. Independent of 'mode' (lora/full), which is the fine-tuning target. devices defaults to cuda:0 for offload.
_comment_chunks: blocks_per_chunk: DiT blocks per streamed chunk (1 = finest, 30 chunks total; raise it to cut per-chunk overhead at the cost of a bigger window). offload_window: GPU slots streamed ahead (>=2 overlaps load with compute). offload_pin: chunks kept permanently resident. offload_backward: 'checkpoint' (per-chunk recompute, dropout-safe, cheapest VRAM) or 'keep' (fastest, holds every chunk's graph). offload_grad_accum: where microbatch gradients accumulate. 'stream' keeps them on the GPU and spills once at flush — a 26% win for full FT, but a 22% LOSS in lora mode (measured), because the trainable slice is small enough that host-side adds are cheap while the GPU accumulator slots thrash. Hence 'cpu' here and 'stream' in the full configs. offload_activations streams saved activations to pinned CPU — only worth it with backward='keep'. Peak weight VRAM ~ (window+pin)/chunks of the model.
_comment_batch: batch_size is PER MICROBATCH; effective batch = batch_size * n_microbatches.
_comment_timeshift: K2 uses a resolution-aware shifted logit-uniform schedule. mu = ln(alpha) where alpha is BFL's shift parameter. For fine-tuning the pretrained model stay in-distribution: use the same y1/y2 K2 was trained with. To train from scratch on the Qwen VAE set mu_override~1.53.
_comment_eval: eval_interval: steps between preview grids (0 disables previews; each preview streams the whole DiT once per CFG branch per sampler step).
_comment_ckpt: Path to the K2 DiT base weights (safetensors). See checkpoints/README.md.
_comment_mode: mode='lora' (default): LoRA adapters on all nn.Linear + unfrozen norms/mods, whole model bf16 (halves PCIe traffic vs fp32). mode='full': fp32 masters + bf16 autocast compute — see train_offload_full.json for the host-RAM budget. In full mode, resume priority: full_checkpoint > lora_checkpoint (merged into mmdit_checkpoint) > mmdit_checkpoint.
